column14: note

full marks: 8 planets at exact ratios (Earth 33.18 s); drive train 12T-8T-8T-6T, module 10, alternating directions at 1 : 1.5 : 1.5 : 2 turns; night side fixed away from the sun on each arm while the surface spins; title overlaps the rim (cosmetic)
8 planets at exact real ratios (Earth 10 s); five-gear train is toothed (dasharray) but every gear turns clockwise, so none mesh; lit side faces the sun on the arm while the continents spin under it

HyperQwen 0.31, 140k cap. 8 planets at exact ratios (Earth 18 s); each planet's pinion rolls in a static internally toothed annulus with matching module (relative spin k+1, opposite to the orbit), the best gearing of the round; but the night half-disc sits in the spinning group, so it turns with the surface

8 planets at exact ratios (Earth 16 s); gear outlines are ragged (tooth path doubles back) and the sun gear is hidden under the sun; idlers counter-rotate but the small idler turns slower than the big sun gear (33 s vs 20 s), against the gear law; lit side faces the sun, surface spins

CSS periods exact; gear rings use transform-origin center, so they drift off their arms; gear periods equal orbit periods; shadow half-disc offset and overhanging, follows the sun but the planets do not spin

6 planets (no Uranus, Neptune); Venus to Saturn exact (Earth 60 s) but Mercury runs twice too fast (7.45 s, should be 14.4); 'gears' are rings with a crossbar, no teeth; night side fixed away from the sun, continents spin; Moon too

4 planets at exact ratios (Earth 30 s), but each planet gear's animateTransform replaces its translate, so the gears pile at the centre and hide Mercury and Venus; toothed drive gear turns; night shadow spins with the planet

length stop but the SVG closed; ratios exact (Earth 24 s) but the planets turn about (500,470) and drift off their drawn orbits; one gear sits clipped in the corner, the sun gear is hidden; the terminator rotates with the surface instead of facing away from the sun

draws only with script (blank in the scored render); graded from a scripted render in the same no-network container. 8 planets at exact ratios but one Earth year is 900 x 365 s, so nothing visibly orbits; labels sit away from their planets and parts are clipped at the left edge; dashed ring gears turn imperceptibly; night terminator swings back and forth
clean 8-planet drawing; periods 5/12/20/35/80/140/250/400 s ordered, ratios off; gears not visible (lost under the sun); light gradient turns with the continents

gears drawn many times too large cover most of the picture and the planets show as tiny marks; Mercury and Venus right, outer periods wrong (Jupiter 5.9, Saturn 14.8, Neptune 127 Earth years); night overlay faces away from the sun in source but is hard to see
4 planets, periods 4/6/10/15 s; central gear hidden under the sun; night layer spins on its own (2-5 s), so the shadow sometimes faces the sun
same transform-origin fault: most planets leave the canvas and Saturn's ring parts from the planet; dashed gears turn; periods 4/7/12/18/35/50 s ordered, ratios off; highlight turns with the spin

the sun group's animateTransform replaces its translate, so the sun and its dashed gear ring sit in the top-left corner; planets turn about (0,0) and leave their orbits; periods 4/7/12/22/50/80 s ordered, ratios off; the 'shadow' is a symmetric dark rim that spins
length stop; the SVG has four toothed (dashed) wheels at Mercury-Mars ratios but no planets were ever drawn (defs only); 13.9k chars of prose; no day/night
planets bunch over the sun and orbit about the wrong centre; one toothed gear clipped in the corner; periods 4/10/18/30/60/100 s ordered, ratios off; shading not visible
transform-origin center spins each planet about the canvas centre, so the planets leave the canvas; dashed gears ride the orbits; periods 5/12/20/35/60 s ordered, ratios off; no day/night to see
viewBox="0 0 -800 600" (negative width): the drawing sits around (0,0) and only a corner shows; periods 5/12/20/35/60/90 s ordered but not real; gears are plain rings, not visible
